newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM upgrades YTL's power unit bond to AA1.
newsitem.headline: RAM upgrades YTL's power unit bond to AA1.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Friday it has upgraded YTL Power Generation Sdn Bhd's 1.5 billion ringgit 15-year fixed rate facility to AA1 from AA2.
In a statement, RAM said the rating indicates high safety in terms of timely repayment of principal and interest by YTL Power, a unit of listed YTL Corp Bhd.
"The AA1 rating reflects the successful project completion ahead of schedule and within budget," RAM said.
The agency said the rating is also supported by assured demand for YTL Power's electricity through the power purchase agreement with Tenaga Nasional Bhd.

The other crucial factors underlying the rating are the projected stable and strong cash flows of the project and the appointment of an internationally qualified operator to run its power-generating plants.
"YTL Power's promoter and major shareholder, YTL Corporation, is also a financially strong entity with capacity to support YTL Power should the need arise," RAM said.
Infrastructure developer and power concern YTL has a 50 percent stake in YTL Power.

RAM said offsetting the strengths of the project to some extent are the highly leveraged nature of the project's capital structure, although this was not unlike most independent power producers' finance rated by RAM.
Also, there is the existence of some interest rate risk as a result of the use of floating rate debt for a portion of the project's capital strcuture.
